# Database schema

62 tables, 59 of them tenant-scoped, plus 69 indexes.

The schema is defined once, in `src/lib/schema/`, as an ordered list of
idempotent statements. There is no migration runner: the same list creates a
fresh database and brings a deployed one up to date on every cold start.

A **tenant-scoped** table carries a `tenant_id` column, and every query against
one must filter by the tenant id taken from the session.
`npm run check:tenancy` enforces that mechanically.

## Indexes

| Index | On |
|---|---|
| `roles_tenant_key_idx` | roles (tenant_id, key) WHERE tenant_id IS NOT NULL |
| `roles_system_key_idx` | roles (key) WHERE tenant_id IS NULL |
| `users_tenant_employee_code_idx` | users (tenant_id, employee_code) WHERE employee_code IS NOT NULL |
| `vendors_tenant_code_idx` | vendors (tenant_id, vendor_code) WHERE vendor_code IS NOT NULL |
| `accounts_tenant_key_idx` | accounts (tenant_id, key) WHERE key IS NOT NULL |
